\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}

% Populate the PDF document information dictionary so tests can assert that
% `pdf-inspector`'s document info fields reach `Document.metadata`. Values are
% deliberately distinctive and fixed (no timestamps) for stable assertions.
\pdfinfo{
  /Title (Document Info Fixture)
  /Author (Ada Lovelace)
  /Subject (Metadata extraction)
  /Keywords (alpha, beta, gamma)
  /Creator (pdfinfo-probe)
  /Producer (pdfinfo-probe producer)
  /CreationDate (D:20240115103000+01'00')
  /ModDate (D:20240220120000+01'00')
}

\begin{document}

This fixture exists to carry a PDF document information dictionary. Its body
text only needs to be extractable: the interesting content lives in the
\verb|/Title|, \verb|/Author|, \verb|/Subject|, \verb|/Keywords|,
\verb|/Creator|, \verb|/Producer|, \verb|/CreationDate| and \verb|/ModDate|
entries above, which automated tests assert against the parsed document's
metadata.

\end{document}
